✦ ═─═─═─  Important Information   ─═─═─═ ✦

⋄ Character designs may be simplified or slightly adjusted if necessary.

⋄ Chibi style only.

⋄ Each commission usually takes 1–3 working days once I start working on it. Thank you for your patience! :3

⋄ If there are many commissions in the queue, the waiting time may be several months or longer. If you're in a hurry, please consider purchasing the Rush Slot, or refrain from commissioning. óωò
[>>> Click here to check the commission queue! <<<]

⋄ Payment methods : Bank Transfer (Taiwan) / PayPal (+5% transaction fee)

⋄ For easier management, I only communicate through Facebook / Telegram / Discord

⋄ For two-character commissions, please try to avoid poses with excessive or very close physical contact due to the chibi proportions. (For example, hugging may not work very well because their large heads get in the way.)

process:
✦ ═─═─═─ Commission Process ─═─═─═ ✦
1. Join the Queue  



After submitting this form, you'll be added to the commission queue.
[>>> Click here to check the commission queue! <<<]

When it's your turn, I'll contact you to discuss the commission details, such as the pose, mood, or any other requests. :3

2. Sketch Approval & Payment  

I'll send you the sketch for approval, confirm the final price, and collect full payment before continuing.
3. Illustration  



After finishing the illustration, I'll send it to you for confirmation.

At this stage, I only accept corrections for mistakes in your character's design or the background. Other revisions are not available.

4. Animation  



If you ordered the animation add-on, I'll begin animating your commission.(Skip this step if you ordered illustration only.)

5. Delivery



I'll send you a Google Drive download link.

Just open the link and download your files! :3
